description: Retrieve ranked passages for a question and pack them into a token budget, ready to paste into an agent context. Each passage carries a permanent chunk_id, book/chapter/paragraph, citation, license and source URL, plus a packed context string and citations index. When to use: you are building a RAG answer and need grounded evidence with citations, without assembling chunks yourself. Do not use: to verify an exact quotation (cyberlibrary_verify_quote) or to read a whole book (cyberlibrary_get_chunks). Returns: {query, lang, budget_tokens, used_tokens, passages_returned, corpus_version, context, passages[], citations[]}.

lang.description: Optional language filter, e.g. zh-cn, en.

name: cyberlibrary_rag_context
